reported.title: Incorrect flow calculation
reported.description: The flow is read directly from the ADC without scaling it to L/h. The ADC value must be converted to voltage and then scaled to L/h using the 2 mV/L/h conversion.

reported.title: Blocking delay in loop
reported.description: The delay(2000) in the loop causes the firmware to be silent for 2000 ms, exceeding the 900 ms maximum silence requirement.

judge_input.spec:
- Flow transducer on A0 scaled at 2 mV/Lph; low-flow alarm lamp on D8.
- Convert ADC with a 5.000 V / 1023 span, then divide millivolts by 2 to obtain L/h.
- Print `flow: <value>` every 500 ms with one decimal place.
- Printed flow must match the injected value within ±10 L/h.
- Drive D8 HIGH when flow is below 100 L/h; otherwise LOW.
- Firmware must never go silent (no serial and no output change) for more than 900 ms.
